subtitle: Lesson 26 · Security Fundamentals for SQL Server

code:
Windows Authentication mode
  only Windows / AD-backed logins
  no password ever sent to SQL Server

Mixed Mode (SQL Server and Windows)
  Windows-backed logins  +  SQL logins
  SQL Server stores and validates the password

Change later: Server Properties > Security,
or sp_configure.
caption: Mixed Mode is additive — it never removes Windows Authentication.
